<div class="card-body">
'''Luke's Cape''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ルークのケープ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2フォース使用して任意の反乱軍かエイリアンに配備する。そのキャラクターは耐：損耗＜3を得る。加えて、「ルークのケープ」がタトゥイーン以外の位置カード上に配備されているなら、毎ターン余分に1フォース起動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Lukes-Cape-PSA-89673879.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルークがパイロットとしてこれから繰り広げる冒険と、迫り来る運命を象徴するかのようにはためくケープ。「おまえは今、新たな世界への一歩を踏み出したのだ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Luke's Cape.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on any Rebel or alien. That character gains immunity to attrition less than 3. If Luke’s Cape is deployed at a location card other than Tatooine, you may also activate one extra Force each turn.

'''Lore:'''
Luke’s cape billows as if to symbolize his future adventures as a pilot and the destiny approaching him. “You have now taken a step into a new world.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face describes Luke’s Cape as deployed at a location card other than Tatooine.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Luke's Cape]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
